changelog:
🧑‍💻 A user panel at /user: whoever holds an API key signs in with it and sees only that key, with its status, limits and settings, requests, failures, credits and tokens over 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or lifetime, usage by model and by client, and its recent requests with their details. The API page gives you the link to send them.
📋 The requests table names the client that called, such as Claude Code, Codex or the Anthropic API, and shows speed and cache hits. Request details show the endpoint's path.
🗝️ The API keys table shows tokens, credits and calls as their own columns. A limit turns amber from 75% and red once it is used up, the same on every page.
🔗 The public link shows as Live only once it opens from the internet. Tailscale can take a few minutes to put a new link online, and the settings card now says so while it waits.
⏰ After your computer wakes from sleep, tokens and usage refresh within a minute. Before, accounts could show "Token expired" for up to half an hour after waking.
🎨 Cards, dialogs and sheets pad 16 px on every side, the accounts and backups tables are quieter, backup notes are in plain words, and links turn purple on hover. With more contrast turned on in your system, secondary text and lines are darker.
